title: Game Pack Show Cues (cues.json) — v1
description: The pack's show-control content (Phase 3 A3 slice 4; design: docs/plans/2026-08-29-phase3-a3-slice4-showcontrol-pack.md in ALN-Ecosystem). This schema is the authoring half of the cue contract (capability-matrix row 2.22). The activation gate is the runtime half. The shape is the engine contract as built. A cue has `commands` or a `timeline`, never both. Timeline entries are flat {at, action, payload} objects. `trigger` may be an event object, a clock object, null, or absent; null and absent both mean the cue fires manually only. The trigger event enum and the condition op enum copy the engine tables (standingEvaluator EVENT_NORMALIZERS and CONDITION_OPS); a contract test fails when either side changes alone. One deliberate difference from the pre-slice-4 venue file: `lighting:scene:activate` payloads carry a `role` from game.json `lightingRoles`, never a concrete venue scene id. The installation profile binds each role to an instrument (B8). The gate enforces what this schema cannot express: unique cue ids, roles declared in lightingRoles, actions the engine can drive, at most one video entry per timeline.

schemaVersion.description: The pack-wide schema version (strings sidecar precedent) — one exact-match number for the whole pack, never a per-sidecar series.

roleName.description: A lighting role: a show event the pack names (e.g. 'police-arrival-2'). Must appear in game.json lightingRoles (gate-checked).

triggerEvent.description: The engine's cue-triggerable event vocabulary (row 2.22). Drift-tripwired against standingEvaluator EVENT_NORMALIZERS — grow BOTH together.

conditionOp.description: Condition operators. Drift-tripwired against standingEvaluator CONDITION_OPS.

field.description: A flat field from the trigger event's normalizer (e.g. tokenId, teamId, phaseId). Field sets are per-event; see the normalizer table.

value.description: The comparison value. For op 'in' this must be an array (a scalar would silently never match at runtime).

trigger.description: null (or an absent trigger key) = manual fire only. An event trigger fires on a matching engine event; a clock trigger fires once when the game clock reaches HH:MM:SS. Conditions exist only on event triggers — the engine never evaluates them for clock triggers.

clock.description: Game-clock threshold as HH:MM:SS (an unparseable string would throw out of the tick listener at runtime; the gate refuses it first).

lightingPayloadRule.description: Pack cues address lights by ROLE. A concrete venue sceneId is schema-illegal here — concrete ids live only in the installation profile bindings and the temporary game.json lightingRoleFallbacks block (ledger L7).

action.description: An engine cue action (e.g. sound:play, lighting:scene:activate, video:queue:add). Schema-open; the activation gate refuses actions the engine cannot drive.

timelineEntry.description: FLAT {at, action, payload} — never a nested command object. `at` is seconds from cue start (three-segment model, decision E5); entries need not be sorted and `at` values may repeat.

icon.description: A CSS class key on the GM quick-fire grid (NOT a text glyph — contrast game.json modes[].icon). Kept to class-name-safe characters. null means the same as absent (“no icon” — the value the config-tool editor historically wrote for a cleared field); the gate and engine treat both identically, and the pattern binds the string form only.

quickFire.description: Show this cue as a button in the GM quick-fire grid.

once.description: Fire at most once per game session.

duration.description: Display length in seconds for the show-designer timeline view. The config-tool timeline editor reads and writes this field. The ENGINE ignores it; runtime timing derives from the entries' `at` values. Only meaningful on compound cues (dependentRequired pins it to `timeline`).

routing.description: Cue-level audio routing (tier 2 of 3: command target > this map > global route). Keys are the engine's stream names.

commands.description: Flat cue: every command fires immediately. Mutually exclusive with timeline.

timeline.description: Compound cue: timed steps on the three-segment clock (decision E5). Mutually exclusive with commands.
